description: Bella Noor Skin Concierge helps users choose skincare treatments in New York City based on skin goals, sensitivity, event timing, location, and treatment interest. It supports treatment recommendations, HydraFacial vs DMK comparisons, dermaplaning and Osmosis guidance, prep and aftercare education, Bella Noor location details, and booking-link guidance. The app provides general skincare education only and does not diagnose, prescribe, collect leads, or complete bookings.

defaultPrompt: What facial should I get in NYC for dull, dehydrated skin before an event?
